purpose: Versioned deterministic pattern set for the tamper guard conversational trigger (FIX-PLAN Item 32, design Section 4.2 rules D2 and the Section 5 exempt-claim signal, plus the Section 4.3 judgment rubric signals). Version 2 adds the comprehension markers of the owner ruling of 2026-10-15 (amendment A1): a user turn framed as comprehension or use (how-to questions, business-level asks, the client's own work product or run, troubleshooting, redo requests) is excluded from judgment scoring by construction in score_transcript, before any signal phrase in it is counted, unless the turn names an internal artifact or a verbatim-text extraction phrase. Tuned for precision over recall, per design Section 4.2: ordinary usage language must not match. The judgment layer, not this file, carries recall. Every Section 4.4 worked example is exercised against this set by the acceptance suite.
